company.name: Infosys Limited
company.description: India-headquartered global provider of AI-first business consulting, technology, outsourcing, cloud, digital transformation and related services to organizations across multiple industries and countries.

sources.name: Infosys Three Year Overview - Consolidated INR

key_risks: Revenue and profitability are exposed to reductions or delays in discretionary technology spending caused by macroeconomic weakness, geopolitical uncertainty and client cost-control programs.

A substantial portion of revenue is earned in foreign currencies, particularly the US dollar, euro, pound sterling and Australian dollar, creating translation and transaction exposure despite hedging.

Rapid AI and other technology disruption requires continuing investment in reskilling, intellectual property and service delivery while increasing competition from global technology providers and new AI-native entrants.
Cybersecurity incidents, data-privacy failures or disruption of client systems could create contractual liabilities, remediation costs and reputational damage.
The business depends on attracting and retaining skilled personnel and is exposed to wage inflation, employee attrition and immigration or work-authorization restrictions.

Trade receivables and unbilled revenue are largely unsecured. Collection quality depends on client creditworthiness, milestone acceptance and timely billing, although the company reported no single customer contributing more than 10% of outstanding trade receivables and unbilled revenue at March 31, 2026.
The company has significant exposure to evolving tax, labour, privacy, AI, immigration and other regulations across numerous jurisdictions.
Acquisitions create integration, contingent-consideration, goodwill and intangible-asset impairment risks.
recent_material_events: Infosys completed a tender-offer buyback of 100,000,000 equity shares at Rs 1,800 per share. The Rs 18,000 crore buyback was completed and the shares were extinguished on December 4, 2025.

The Government of India labour codes notified on November 21, 2025 resulted in an additional consolidated gratuity and compensated-absence charge of Rs 1,289 crore in FY2026 and a related tax benefit of Rs 318 crore.
On March 25, 2026, Infosys announced a definitive agreement to acquire Stratus, a property-and-casualty insurance technology and consulting company.

Q1 FY2027 revenue was Rs 48,211 crore and profit attributable to owners was Rs 7,769 crore. Infosys revised FY2027 constant-currency revenue-growth guidance to 1.5%-3.0% and retained operating-margin guidance of 20%-22%.
Infosys reported no material cybersecurity incident in its FY2025-26 ESG reporting.

assumptions.title: EBITDA derived from operating profit and depreciation
assumptions.what_we_assumed: EBITDA equals company-reported operating profit plus depreciation and amortization.
assumptions.why_we_assumed_it: Infosys does not present EBITDA as a primary audited line item, while operating profit and depreciation and amortization are separately disclosed.
assumptions.how_we_applied_it: Added depreciation and amortization to operating profit for each fiscal year.

source.name: Infosys annual reports and Three Year Overview

assumptions.title: Cash and current investments definition
assumptions.what_we_assumed: Cash and current investments comprises reported cash and cash equivalents plus current financial investments, without adding non-current investments or other financial assets.
assumptions.why_we_assumed_it: The requested schema specifically asks for cash and current investments rather than Infosys's broader non-GAAP 'consolidated cash and investments' measure.
assumptions.how_we_applied_it: Summed the two audited consolidated balance-sheet lines for each year.

assumptions.title: Borrowings exclude lease liabilities
assumptions.what_we_assumed: Borrowings are conventional interest-bearing bank loans, bonds and similar debt; Ind AS 116 lease liabilities are not classified as borrowings.
assumptions.why_we_assumed_it: Infosys explicitly describes itself as debt-free and states that finance cost is principally attributable to leases, while lease liabilities are presented separately on the balance sheet.
assumptions.how_we_applied_it: Recorded borrowings as zero for all five fiscal year ends and retained lease-related finance cost in interest expense.

assumptions.title: Net profit basis
assumptions.what_we_assumed: Net profit means profit attributable to owners of Infosys Limited after non-controlling interests.
assumptions.why_we_assumed_it: This is the profit measure highlighted by Infosys for shareholders and avoids including profits attributable to minority investors.
assumptions.how_we_applied_it: Used the profit attributable to owners for each fiscal year.

assumptions.title: Free cash flow reporting basis
assumptions.what_we_assumed: Used Infosys's directly reported IFRS free cash flow rather than recomputing it from the Ind AS CFO and capital-expenditure figures included elsewhere in the dataset.
assumptions.why_we_assumed_it: Infosys defines and publishes free cash flow under IFRS, and INR translations of IFRS cash flows can differ from Ind AS INR cash-flow figures because the IFRS INR presentation is translated from functional currencies using applicable exchange rates.
assumptions.how_we_applied_it: Used the company-reported IFRS free cash flow values for each fiscal year.

assumptions.title: Market capitalization derived from price and shares outstanding
assumptions.what_we_assumed: Market capitalization equals the August 21, 2026 NSE price multiplied by the latest company-reported shares outstanding at June 30, 2026.
assumptions.why_we_assumed_it: A directly displayed same-date market-capitalization figure was not available from the selected market-price source.
assumptions.how_we_applied_it: Multiplied the NSE price by shares outstanding and converted rupees to Rs crore.

source.name: Infosys Shareholder Structure and Kotak Neo Infosys Market Data

assumptions.title: June 2026 shareholding category selection
assumptions.what_we_assumed: Selected promoter, FII and DII percentages from secondary aggregators that most closely reconciled to the official share count and to one another.
assumptions.why_we_assumed_it: The official Infosys shareholder page confirmed the June 30, 2026 share count but did not expose all category percentages in searchable text, while secondary sources reported conflicting classifications.
assumptions.how_we_applied_it: Selected the promoter, FII and DII holdings that best reconciled across sources. The disagreements are separately recorded in discrepancies.

data_quality_notes: All annual financial-statement figures are consolidated and stated in Rs crore.

Income statement, balance sheet and CFO figures are primarily taken from audited consolidated Ind AS statements. Free cash flow is the company's separately reported IFRS measure and therefore should not be expected to equal the reported Ind AS CFO minus Ind AS capital expenditure.
Finance cost is predominantly lease-related. Infosys reported that it remained debt-free; lease liabilities are nevertheless material and are shown separately from borrowings in its balance sheet.

Receivables are net trade receivables after expected-credit-loss allowances and exclude unbilled revenue. At March 31, 2026, consolidated unbilled revenue was Rs 13,706 crore in addition to Rs 35,234 crore of trade receivables.

The March 31, 2026 consolidated balance sheet reported lease liabilities of Rs 9,176 crore, comprising Rs 6,016 crore non-current and Rs 3,160 crore current liabilities; these have not been included in borrowings_cr.

No current external credit rating for Infosys Limited was located in the reviewed primary sources. This is consistent with the company's debt-free status but does not prove that no rating exists for every subsidiary or facility.
June 2026 shareholding percentages have lower confidence because searchable secondary aggregators disagree and classify ADR custodian and institutional categories differently.
The market price is the latest available completed trading-day price before the requested research date of Saturday, August 22, 2026.
